description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Graves''' fires an explosive shell in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and causes him to [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|recoil]] 400 units in the opposite direction.
description.text: Active: Graves fires an explosive shell in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and causes him to recoil 400 units in the opposite direction.

description2.raw: Upon hitting an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes in a cone to deal reduced damage to additional enemies.
description2.text: Upon hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes in a cone to deal reduced damage to additional enemies.

leveling.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
275 / 350 / 425 / 500 / 575 (+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)

leveling2.raw:
'''Reduced Damage:'''
200 / 260 / 320 / 380 / 440 (+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * Applies [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Spell damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]] to the target hit by the shell (including to non-champions struck before exploding(bug)) and [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]] to targets within the explosion cone. * The projectile will still explode early if the champion hit by the shell is protected by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * The explosion cone is anchored on the location of the shell missile when it collided with a champion, or otherwise its maximum cast range. * The cone damage is always located 150 units behind, based off its direction * ''Collateral Damage'' is not disabled while [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] or [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]], but '''Graves''' will not dash after the cast time while affected by them. * '''Graves''' will not [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] after the cast time if he is [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]]. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
Applies spell damage to the target hit by the shell (including to non-champions struck before exploding(bug)) and area damage to targets within the explosion cone.
The projectile will still explode early if the champion hit by the shell is protected by a spell shield.
The explosion cone is anchored on the location of the shell missile when it collided with a champion, or otherwise its maximum cast range.
The cone damage is always located 150 units behind, based off its direction
Collateral Damage is not disabled while grounded or rooted, but Graves will not dash after the cast time while affected by them.
Graves will not dash after the cast time if he is airborne.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
